title: Resources Carousel & Rapid-Config Screens for Dedicated Onboarding
creator: Marina Cortez
description: Design a compact, scannable set of onboarding visuals and quick-config screens targeted at teams provisioning Dedicated capacity. Deliverables: a resources carousel (preview of instance SKUs, expected throughput, cost profiles), a rapid-config wizard with three hero flows (Small / Balanced / Throughput), microcopy for SLA/availability tradeoffs, and a set of annotated product screenshots for docs and release notes. Focus on reducing first-time setup time and clarifying SLA implications for autoscale and reserved pools.
background_and_goals: Problem: customers are overwhelmed by capacity choices during first run and often pick suboptimal SKUs leading to cost or latency regressions.
Goal 1: reduce time-to-provision for new Dedicated customers by 40% by presenting a lightweight path with recommended defaults.
Goal 2: surface SLA tradeoffs clearly so engineering and ops stakeholders can align on availability vs cost.
Goal 3: provide a set of assets (Figma frames, PNG screenshots, and copy snippets) that docs and product marketing can reuse in the release bundle.
requirements: Carousel must show 3-4 representative node types with concise metrics: nominal throughput (tokens/s), estimated monthly cost, and recommended workload archetype.
Rapid-config wizard should be a 3-step flow: use-case selection -> traffic profile slider -> autoscale + SLA recommendation summary.
Include an SLA explainer panel with fallback behavior (canary -> full rollout -> auto-fallback to lower-cost variant) and SLOs (p99 latency, availability target).
Provide lightweight accessibility label copy for each visual and ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA.
Deliver final exportable assets: Figma file link, annotated PNGs (desktop / mobile widths), and a short copy deck for docs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames uploaded to the Dedicated Onboarding file with componentized carousel elements.
Three completed hero screenshots (desktop) annotated and exported to Drive with naming convention DO-67129-*.png.
PM sign-off on microcopy and SLA explainer language.
Engineering review completed for feasibility of in-console layout and animation budget.
Design tokens and spacing follow Redwood UI system guidance and are documented in the same Figma page.
